summary: A machining-oriented aluminium extrusion alloy referenced for rod, bar and hexagonal stock. Material composition and the finished use require separate review.
guidance: The published chemistry includes lead and bismuth additions. Check the specified composition against end-use substance requirements rather than assuming compliance. Weld heat can reduce strength in the heat-treated condition.
